integrity: Every finite computation is fully reproducible with the bundled standard-library Python source and certificate; all nonzero Smith factors are established as units by exact integer operations. No independent human audit or mathematical certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Results are exhaustive for nonperiodic square boards of sizes one through six. They determine reduced integral homology, not unrestricted-size homology, all attaching maps, full homotopy types, or symmetry representations. Earlier equivalent unpublished or unindexed calculations may exist.
title: Integral homology of the first six king-configuration complexes
